CustomField.description: Lot size in acres, carried from Lead.Lot_Size_Acres__c at conversion. The existing Lot_Size__c field is square feet, entered from the Offering Memorandum by an analyst — this field is NOT derived from that one, and conversion never writes to Lot_Size__c (deriving SF from acres is forbidden by this module's anti-hallucination rules).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Carried from the Lead at conversion; null when not stated in the email. Distinct from Lot Size (which is square feet, from the OM).
CustomField.label: Lot Size (Acres)
